gloss_en: The perfection/completion (shlemut) of the Holy Tongue — the state in which lashon ha-kodesh is made whole by elevating the good within Targum/the seventy languages; a quality attained by a person (paradigmatically Joseph) that rectifies the covenant (tikkun ha-brit), cools sexual heat, saves from nocturnal emission, illumines the letters within every created thing, and enables dream interpretation (Likutey Moharan I:19). Not the Holy Tongue itself, but its state of completeness.
